facts.text: Must complete cloud migration setup before configuring Dynamics GP company migration.
Set global dimensions by selecting two segments from GP to use as global dimensions; remaining segments auto-configure as shortcut dimensions.
Choose modules to migrate using module switches; disabling Payables automatically disables Open Purchase Orders.
Specify Oldest GL Year field to determine which years migrate; if empty, all years migrate.
Master data only option allows migrating bank account information without bank transactions.
Multiple dimensions from GP require manual per-company configuration if companies use different segment counts.
Recurring sales and purchase lines auto-generate based on accounts assigned to customers, vendors, classes, or default posting setup.
Classes migrate as posting groups with matching names for customers, vendors, and items.
